messages:
rachel: starting a config-only rollout for routing/batching tweaks + timeout tighten. change window 11:15-11:30 PT. will stage by tenant cohorts and do manual pins for any paid-critical tenants. release doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/rc-2026-03-21-b.json

tomo: can you list exact keys being changed?

rachel: changes: 
- routing.weight_floor 0.025 -> 0.05
- tiny_batch.max_tokens 48 -> 28
- batching.min_delay_ms 5 -> 3
- per_request.timeout_ms 20000 -> 14000
- prefer_local_region: true filter for tenants with tag "eu-regional"
(only config, no binary/model changes)

vishal: recommend cohorts: A=internal/dev, B=low-traffic non-prod tenants, C=paid-critical (manual). 3m observe per stage.

jen: deploy-bot queue please. ops on standby for quick pin/unwind.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued config rc-2026-03-21-b -> prod. canary cohort A scheduled at 1712367890. automated rollback window until 1712368190. Use /deploy abort to stop.

ops-lee: putting temp dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/routing/rc-2026-03-21-b. Alerts: 95p latency +25% or 5xx +0.4% or avg batch size drop >35% trigger hold.

rachel: corrected filter: prefer_local_region only when tenant.tags includes "eu-regional". updating rollout filter config now.

deploy-bot: cohort A started at 11:15 PT applying to 0.5% traffic (internal dev).

vishal: quick smoke: latency looks stable, small batch size reduction ~12% expected. no 5xx.

jen: proceed to cohort B?

deploy-bot: promoting to cohort B at 11:19 PT -> 8% traffic.

ops-lee: rollback playbook updated: 
1) /deploy abort to stop rollout
2) pin tenant to previous config rc-2026-03-07 if isolated failure
3) if >1.5% 5xx across >2m escalate to eng-runtime

rachel: note for paid-critical: we'll do manual pinning instead of auto promotion if any anomaly.

deploy-bot: cohort B healthy, starting manual approval for cohort C.

vishal: manual approval granted. cohort C start 11:23 PT: initial 25% then ramp to 100% over 10m if stable.

jen: support heads-up: tightened timeouts may cause integration retries; flag to support and SRE to watch logs for client-side errors.

ops-lee: rolling cohort C. watchlist set for top 15 paid tenants.

deploy-bot: cohort C at 25%, monitoring metrics.

rachel: 90s in see spike of 502s for tenant t-777, error bursts concentrated to a single region.

ops-lee: isolating t-777, applying manual pin for only that tenant back to rc-2026-03-07 routing.weight_floor. routing split adjusted to route them to fallback pool.

deploy-bot: manual pin applied for tenant t-777 -> pinned to rc-2026-03-07. traffic redistributed.

vishal: after pin the tenant's errors dropped and latency returned to baseline. batch size also recovered for that tenant.

rachel: decision: continue full rollout for others, keep t-777 pinned. mark rollout as partial-complete with one tenant isolated. create postmortem and integration ticket to run tightened timeout tests against t-777's integrations.

deploy-bot: rollout completed: 96% tenants updated, 1% pinned (t-777), 3% paused/staged. reference this thread id 1712367890 for postmortem.

jen: thanks all. I'll update release notes and support ticket template. ops-lee: you can stand down in 20m unless anything else pops up.

ops-lee: noted. leaving monitoring for 30m. thanks.
